svg.title: How agent-mesh works
svg.desc: Sequence: 1 your agent's key is created in the TPM. 2 your mesh sends a JOIN request with the key fingerprint to Bob's mesh. 3 Bob confirms the fingerprint with you directly and approves it. 4 the two meshes find each other on the DHT, prove the team secret and open a Noise-encrypted link. 5 your agent runs mesh ask; the signed message travels to Bob's mesh and is typed into Bob's idle agent. 6 Bob's agent replies; the reply is shown only if Bob's key is approved, and your ask returns it. 7 if Bob is offline the message is sealed into the encrypted mailbox in the hive and delivered when he starts. 8 both sides share tasks, file leases, decisions, contracts and notes through the hive.
